@title 15market Treasury
 @dev Authoritative prediction market contract. The CONTRACT decides win/loss
      on-chain by comparing the settled exit price against the stored entry price.
 Lifecycle:
   1. placeBet()  — user stakes USDC and the entry price/direction are stored on-chain.
   2. settleBet() — backend supplies the exit price; the contract determines `won`
                    itself and pays the backend-provided dynamic payout amount.
 The backend cannot mark a trade wrong: the win/loss decision lives on-chain.
 The backend only supplies the exit price (its price oracle) and the off-chain
 computed payout amount (dynamic share pricing).

@dev Settle a bet. Authority restricted to Owner (Backend).
      The CONTRACT determines the result on-chain by comparing the exit
      price against the stored entry price, then transfers the
      backend-provided payout amount from the Treasury to the payoutAddress.
      A tie (exit == entry) is a PUSH: the original stake is refunded.
